items.statement: The independent investigation preserves the supplied neutral singlet molecular identities and documents conformer handling, geometry convergence/stationarity, amine-site mapping and descriptor definitions.
items.expected: All ODA, 6FODA, PFMB and TMC records are charge 0/multiplicity 1 with unchanged connectivity; the report states a reproducible conformer and convergence procedure and identifies the amine sites.

items.statement: The inter-benzene dihedral is defined consistently as C1–C2–X–C3, with X=O for ODA/6FODA and X=C for PFMB.
items.expected: The report states this selector and uses equivalent atom identities consistently for all three diamines.

items.statement: The source reports nucleophilicity indices of ODA 4.26 eV, 6FODA 3.68 eV and PFMB 3.56 eV.
items.expected: The submitted values and descriptor name/units are close to these source values, or a clearly justified alternative descriptor is reported with an explicit comparison and limitation.

items.statement: The source-supported revised interpretation is ODA > 6FODA > PFMB, with optimized dihedrals 75.2°, 81.6° and 77.1°.
items.expected: The report independently derives and discusses the ordering and gives identity-bound dihedral results; disagreement is allowed only with evidence and analysis.

items.statement: Descriptor calculations support comparative mechanistic interpretation but are not direct experimental kinetic measurements.
items.expected: The conclusion states this model limitation and distinguishes computed descriptors from reaction rates and membrane performance.
